description: This file defines the HeartbeatReceiver class in Apache Spark, responsible for receiving and managing heartbeat messages from executors to monitor their liveness and handle executor timeouts.

classes.name: Heartbeat
classes.description: A case class representing a heartbeat message from executors, including executor ID, accumulator updates, block manager ID, and executor metrics.

classes.name: HeartbeatReceiver
classes.description: A class that runs on the Spark driver to receive and process heartbeat messages from executors, manage executor liveness, and handle executor timeouts.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Initializes scheduled task to periodically check for dead hosts based on heartbeat timeouts.

methods.name: receiveAndReply
methods.description: Handles incoming RPC messages such as executor registration, removal, heartbeat messages, and scheduler setup notifications.

methods.name: addExecutor
methods.description: Sends a message to add a new executor; used mainly for testing.

methods.name: onExecutorAdded
methods.description: Handles SparkListener event for executor addition.

methods.name: removeExecutor
methods.description: Sends a message to remove an executor; used mainly for testing.

methods.name: onExecutorRemoved
methods.description: Handles SparkListener event for executor removal.

methods.name: expireDeadHosts
methods.description: Checks for executors that have not sent heartbeats within the timeout and removes them.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Cleans up scheduled tasks and executor threads when the receiver stops.
